tasks.short: File and check personnel documents in the AFAS dossier

today.trigger: A document arrives by mail, Teams, SharePoint, Recruitee or Studytube, or a manager hands one in.
steps: Open the message and work out who it concerns and what kind of document it is.
Check that the name, dates and document type match the person in AFAS.
Type the fields into the dossier and store the PDF.
Ask for anything missing, then tell the manager or the employee it is filed.
drudgery: Re-typing names, dates and certificate numbers that are already on the document
Renaming PDFs and dropping them in the right dossier
Sorting a forklift certificate from a grievance in the same inbox
today.time_sinks: Most of the time goes to opening mail, renaming files, and typing into AFAS what the document already says.

lenses.faster: Opening, renaming and re-typing disappear when the scan is readable. A certificate or staffing form then takes about a minute to confirm, while a grievance, an evaluation or a leave paper still needs several minutes of reading.
lenses.autonomous: A document landing in the HR mailbox or in Studytube starts the read, which proposes the dossier fields and flags gaps. The administrator approves each write before AFAS stores it.
lenses.ambitious: Night-shift supervisors at Tilburg and Venlo can send a certificate photo after the shift and have it confirmed on the file before their next shift, a group that now waits until someone is at a desk. They would send many more certificates this way if it were easy, because a missing VCA or forklift card already keeps someone off the floor, so demand grows as the price of sending one falls.
lenses.joy: Nobody would miss renaming PDFs and typing certificate numbers. The work they want more of is the grievance or the difficult leave, where the wording changes what happens next.
lenses.options: When a leave note or a grievance is unclear, two proposed filings — store it as received, or hold it and ask for a cleaner copy — change whether the HR business partner acts this week.
lenses.altitude: The week shifts to documents the check cannot accept, and to sending weak ones back. They gain the right to block a dossier update that is incomplete or that contains a medical detail, and the job becomes more expert about what may be stored.
reach: Learning and Development Specialist: keep mandatory forklift, VCA and food-safety certificates current on the dossier, after learning the role-and-site list in Studytube.
HR Business Partner: assemble the document set for a grievance, after learning which notes stay with the business partner and the works council.

tasks.human_edge: They can tell a grievance, a performance note and a medical detail apart, and they know when filing a paper in the wrong field would harm someone.
tasks.pattern_why: The document is unstructured and the dossier fields are fixed, so one model call can propose the fields and a rule can flag a missing date or a forbidden detail. The path after that is a single approval, which does not need an agent.

in_practice.trigger: A PDF or photo arrives in the HR mailbox, from Studytube, or from a manager.
steps: The model proposes the employee, the document type, the dates and the dossier fields.
Rules check that the employee exists, the document type is allowed, and a diagnosis is not among the proposed fields.
The administrator sees the proposal beside the original and approves, edits or rejects it.
AFAS stores the approved fields and the original on the dossier.
Rejected documents stay in the queue with the reason.
in_practice.human_gate: The administrator approves every dossier write. A grievance, an evaluation, or any document that mentions health is read in full first.
data_needed: AFAS employee number, name and contract type
Allowed document types per dossier section
Studytube result when the document is a certificate
in_practice.logs_to: The AFAS employee dossier, with the rejection reason kept on the same action.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit 8 reads documents into dossier fields, and new hires submit their data in the Pocket app before day one.
evidence.source: AFAS Profit 8, Jonas and Pocket, https://irixs.nl/kennisbank/afas-profit-8

evidence.claim: Notes and summaries that are filed can capture health details, and the tool is not ready when the employer cannot say where that data goes.
Sickness and other health details are special-category data under GDPR Art. 9 and should stay out of model prompts.

risks: A wrong field on a grievance or a leave can be copied into a later personnel action.
Health text on a sick-leave paper would enter the prompt unless the document is routed past the model.
The works council may need to consent if automatic filing is a new way of processing the personnel file.
The published description of AFAS document reading gives no error rate, so a weak reader would put the full check back on every page.
research_questions: What share of these documents are certificates and standard forms, and what share are grievances, evaluations or sick-leave papers?
On a sample of real Noordhaven documents, how often does AFAS document reading name the right employee and the right fields with no correction?
How often do leave and grievance documents contain a diagnosis or another medical detail?
Will the works council treat automatic filing into the personnel dossier as a change that needs consent under WOR art. 27?

tasks.short: Record addresses, pay, absence, output and leavers in AFAS

today.trigger: An employee, a manager or payroll sends a change of address, earnings, absence, output, a performance note, or a leaving date.
steps: Find the person in AFAS and open the right screen.
Type the address, absence, output, performance note, or leaving date and reason from the mail or the spreadsheet.
Check the change against the contract and the CAO code list.
Save, and pass wage-related changes to the payroll specialist before cutoff.
drudgery: Typing a change that is already in payroll or in a manager's spreadsheet
Copying the same change onto a second list for the pay run
Cleaning addresses that arrive in different formats
today.time_sinks: Re-keying, then checking what was just typed, crowded into the days before payroll cutoff.

lenses.faster: Re-typing a change that already has a trusted source disappears. A conflict takes a few minutes, and a leaving reason or an absence with no code can take about ten minutes because both the pay run and the verzuim record depend on it.
lenses.autonomous: A saved address form, a coded absence, a payroll close or a leaver form starts it, and fields that match the source update AFAS on their own. The administrator sees conflicts, unknown codes, output figures and free-text notes.
lenses.ambitious: The payroll specialist receives a checked file of address, hours and leaver changes two days before cutoff, a service they now rebuild from the HR mailbox. Once they trust it they would ask for allowances and contract hours too, so demand grows if a wrong figure stays rare.
lenses.joy: Nobody would miss typing addresses and earnings that are already on another screen. The work they want more of is a leaving reason or an absence code that will mislead payroll if it is rushed.
lenses.options: When a leaving date or an absence can be coded in two ways, showing the effect of each code on the pay run and on the verzuim figure changes which code is saved.
lenses.altitude: The week gathers around conflicts in the days before cutoff. They gain the right to hold a change that would reach the pay run with an unknown code, and the job becomes more expert about which system owns each fact.
reach: Payroll Specialist: prepare the master-data changes the pay run reads, after learning the cutoff, the wage-related fields and the codes payroll rejects.
People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: keep the nightly AFAS extract free of duplicate employee rows, after learning which fields that extract uses.

tasks.human_edge: They notice when an absence code, a leaving reason or an output figure would send payroll or a manager the wrong signal, and they keep medical detail off the record.
tasks.pattern_why: Address, earnings, absence and leaver data are structured fields with a known source, so rules can copy a match and stop on a conflict. Health text stays on the coded absence form, which keeps a model out of the path.

in_practice.trigger: An employee saves an address on the AFAS form, a manager submits a coded absence or a leaver, or payroll closes the pay run.
steps: Each field has one source. A second source that disagrees waits in the conflict queue.
Known absence and leaver codes post on their own. Unknown codes and free text wait.
Earnings stay in payroll as the source that the dossier shows. Output figures and supervisory notes post only when they arrive on the fixed form.
The administrator clears the queue before cutoff. Diagnosis text is refused by the form.
in_practice.human_gate: The administrator decides every conflict, every unknown absence or leaver code, and every free-text performance note before it is stored.
data_needed: Named source of truth for each field
Allowed absence and leaver codes under both CAOs
Payroll cutoff calendar
Employee number and contract type
in_practice.logs_to: The AFAS employee record, with the conflict queue cleared before each payroll cutoff.

evidence.claim: In AFAS Profit 8, new hires submit their own data in the Pocket app before day one, so those starter fields are captured once.
SAP Joule's HR agents cover time off and timesheets on top of an HR core.
From 2 December 2027, AI that allocates tasks or monitors performance is high-risk under Annex III 4(b).
Absence reasons often contain health data, which is special-category data and should stay out of a model prompt.

risks: A silent overwrite of an address, weekly hours or a leaving date lands in the next pay run.
Absence text often contains health data, so the absence path has to stay a coded form.
Turning output or supervisory notes into a score would move the task toward performance monitoring, which is high-risk from 2 December 2027.
Two live sources for one field will keep flipping the record if the rule has no winner.
research_questions: Which of these fields does HR still type into AFAS even though they already exist in payroll or in a site spreadsheet?
How often does an absence arrive with a diagnosis or a doctor's note attached?
What share of leaver reasons and performance notes has no stable code?
How many pay-run corrections last quarter came from a wrong address, wrong hours or a wrong end date?

tasks.short: Keep AFAS right when people join, move or leave

today.trigger: A recruiter, manager or employee reports a hire, a leave, a transfer, a promotion or a resignation.
steps: Open the AFAS workflow or the employee card for that event.
Type dates, hours, scale, site, cost centre and reason from the mail or the contract.
Check the event against the right CAO and ask for anything missing.
Close the action and tell payroll or the HR business partner when pay or a long absence is affected.
drudgery: Re-entering offer data that is already in Recruitee
Ticking the same hire and leaver checks on every file
Searching the mailbox for the one message that states the start date
today.time_sinks: Waiting for a missing start date, scale or site, then reworking the record when that fact arrives after the action was saved.

lenses.faster: Copying the event into AFAS from the mail disappears. Releasing a clean hire or leaver takes a few minutes, while a promotion that crosses CAO, or a leave that runs into illness, still needs a careful read.
lenses.autonomous: An approved offer, a leave request or a resignation starts it, and AFAS opens the action with the fields that already match. The administrator approves the action before it is committed.
lenses.ambitious: A site manager can have a transfer or a fixed-term extension settled in AFAS before the roster is published, a decision that today often lands after the shifts are already planned. In peak season the three sites would ask for this on more moves if it were ready before roster day, so demand grows as the cycle gets shorter.
lenses.joy: Nobody would miss pasting one start date into three screens. The work they want more of is the event that does not fit the checklist, such as a promotion across CAO or a leaver who is ill.
lenses.options: For a transfer or a promotion, two filled actions — the current CAO scale beside the other site's scale and allowances — can change whether the manager and the HR business partner go ahead this month.
lenses.altitude: The week is the events the workflow cannot close, bunched around start dates and month end. They gain the right to hold an event until the scale, the site and the dates agree, and the job becomes more expert on the lifecycle.
reach: HR Business Partner: prepare the AFAS record for a routine transfer between Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo, after learning when a move changes the CAO or the works-council unit.
Payroll Specialist: hand over a complete leaver or hours change before cutoff, after learning which dates the pay run locks.

tasks.human_edge: They see the clash a checklist misses: notice while the employee is ill, a promotion that jumps from one CAO to the other, or a transfer that is really a new contract.
tasks.pattern_why: The event usually starts as a mail or a signed document with the dates buried in sentences, so one model call can propose the personnel-action fields. The checks after that are rules: the employee exists, the scale is valid, and the dates are in order.

in_practice.trigger: A signed contract, an accepted Recruitee offer, a leave request or a resignation arrives.
steps: The text is read into a proposed AFAS action: event type, dates, hours, site, cost centre and scale.
Rules check the employee, the CAO scale and the order of the dates.
The administrator approves, edits or sends the action back.
On approval, AFAS writes the event and notifies payroll or the HR business partner when pay or a long leave is involved.
Illness during notice, or a missing Wet verbetering poortwachter date, blocks the action.
in_practice.human_gate: The administrator approves each hire, leaver, leave, transfer and promotion before AFAS commits it.
data_needed: Approved offer or signed document
Valid scales and cost centres per site and CAO
Employee contract and current site
Open Wet verbetering poortwachter deadline where a long leave or a leaver exists
in_practice.logs_to: The AFAS personnel action, with blocked actions visible to the HR business partner.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit 8 reads documents into dossier fields, which covers a signed contract or a resignation used to open a personnel action.
A letter can be produced automatically, but a decision with legal effect may not rest solely on automated processing.
Sickness reporting under Wet verbetering poortwachter is rule-bound, while the health content of the file is special-category data and should stay out of a model prompt.

risks: An end date or a scale committed too early flows into the employee's pay.
A leaver or a long leave during illness can miss a Wet verbetering poortwachter date if the action closes on thin data.
A misread resignation date will look tidy on the approval screen.
A promotion posted on the wrong CAO is hard to unwind once the roster and the pay run have used it.
research_questions: How many hire, leave, transfer, promotion and leaver actions are there in a normal month, and how many fields are still typed by hand?
Which of these events already run through an AFAS workflow that managers actually use?
How often is a leaver or a long leave also an illness case with a poortwachter deadline?
On last quarter's actions, what share would have been wrong if the proposed fields had been committed without an edit?

tasks.short: Check whether an applicant meets the vacancy

today.trigger: A recruiter asks for a check, or a candidate arrives in a Recruitee stage waiting for review.
steps: Open the candidate and the vacancy in Recruitee.
Look for the certificates, licence, place and shift the vacancy requires.
See whether the route is Noordhaven employment or an agency flex order, and which CAO applies.
Write a short note to the recruiter and file any certificate the candidate sent.
drudgery: Searching each CV for a VCA card, a forklift certificate or a driving licence
Re-reading the same vacancy text for every candidate
Copying the conclusion into Recruitee and into a mail
today.time_sinks: Reading applications that are missing one obvious fact, and waiting while recruiter and administrator pass the file back and forth.

lenses.faster: Hunting through the CV for a named certificate, a licence and a town disappears. The eligibility conclusion still takes several minutes, and longer when the papers are almost right.
lenses.autonomous: A candidate entering the review stage in Recruitee starts a lineup of stated facts against the vacancy's written must-haves. The administrator writes the eligibility note, and the recruiter decides whether the person proceeds.
lenses.ambitious: Night-shift and weekend warehouse vacancies at Tilburg and Venlo get the same eligibility note as a Rotterdam day role, a group that today waits or is left with the agency. The sites would send more of those vacancies through HR if the note came back the same day, so demand grows once the check is cheap enough to fit a short-notice shift.
lenses.joy: Nobody would miss scanning CVs for an expiry date. The work they want more of is the borderline person a site already knows, where a certificate name is only part of the story.
lenses.options: A factual brief that lists a missing VCA, the site, and whether the route is employment or flex can change whether the recruiter invites the person or asks the agency to fill the shift.
lenses.altitude: The week is the applications the list cannot clear. They gain the right to mark a file incomplete for interview, the hiring decision stays with the recruiter and the manager, and the job becomes more expert on must-haves per site and shift.
reach: Recruiter: do the first completeness check on applications, after learning the written must-haves per vacancy family. The interview and the hiring decision stay with the recruiter.
Compensation and Benefits Specialist: flag when stated hours sit outside the scale written on the vacancy, after learning the two CAO scales at that basic level.

tasks.human_edge: They judge the almost-qualified applicant and the flex worker a site already trusts, and they keep a checklist from turning into a rejection.
tasks.pattern_why: The recruiter remains responsible for who proceeds, and screening applicants is high-risk from 2 December 2027. A draft that lines up facts the applicant stated is the simplest pattern that still leaves the conclusion with a person.

in_practice.trigger: A candidate reaches the review stage in Recruitee.
steps: The vacancy's written must-haves are loaded: certificates, licence, site, shift, and employment or flex.
The model extracts only what the applicant stated and lines it up against that list.
The administrator checks the lineup, reads the borderline files, and writes the eligibility note.
The recruiter decides the next stage. The note records the facts checked and the human conclusion.
in_practice.human_gate: The administrator signs the eligibility note. The recruiter and the hiring manager decide who proceeds. Any message to the candidate is sent by the recruiter.
data_needed: Must-haves written by the recruiter for that vacancy
Application and attachments in Recruitee
Whether the role is Noordhaven employment or an agency order
CAO family of the vacancy
in_practice.logs_to: A note on the Recruitee candidate with the facts checked and the administrator's conclusion.

evidence.claim: A rejection or acceptance letter may be automated, but a decision with legal effect may not rest solely on automated processing.
From 2 December 2027, AI used to screen applicants is high-risk under Annex III 4(a). A policy question-and-answer bot is not in that class.
AI summaries of candidates become a paper trail that recruiters may later have to explain.

risks: A ranking or a filter on applicants would be screening, and from 2 December 2027 a high-risk system.
A note that overstates a certificate can send an unfit person to the floor, or drop a fit one.
Opinions stored on the candidate in Recruitee are personal data the company must be able to explain.
Agency workers are employed by the agency, and a selection file on them can be the wrong employer's processing.
research_questions: Are must-haves written down per role family, and how often do they change?
How many minutes does an eligibility check take today, and how many of those minutes are spent searching for a certificate or a licence?
Would a facts-only lineup still count as screening under Annex III 4(a) once that duty applies? Counsel needs to answer before any filter is added.
What share of people in Recruitee are agency workers, where the staffing agency is the employer?

tasks.short: Answer questions on pay, leave, benefits and certificates

today.trigger: An employee or a manager mails, calls or sends a Teams message about pay, leave, a certificate, eligibility or a benefit.
steps: Read the question and open the person in AFAS to see contract, CAO, site and tenure.
Look up the figure or the rule in AFAS, the CAO text or a SharePoint page.
Write the reply in Dutch and send it.
Pass the question to payroll, the HR business partner or Learning and Development when it is not standard.
drudgery: Answering the same leave-balance, payslip and certificate questions
Looking up a scale that AFAS already shows
Losing the morning to a burst of identical mails on shift-change days
today.time_sinks: Repeat questions, plus searching for the page or the field that holds the answer, across two CAOs and three sites.

lenses.faster: Writing replies that only quote one AFAS field or one SharePoint page disappears, if staff actually use the front door. A question the pages do not cover still takes the same ten to twenty minutes it takes today.
lenses.autonomous: A question in the marked Teams channel starts it. The front door quotes an allowed AFAS field or an approved page, says it is AI, and turns every other question into a ticket the administrator answers.
lenses.ambitious: Night-shift and weekend crews at Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo get answers during the shift, a group that now waits until the office opens or asks a supervisor to guess. They would use it more if it were there at 22:00, so demand grows once night access is cheap, because those crews already need leave, certificate and allowance answers while HR is closed.
lenses.joy: Nobody would miss the tenth leave-balance mail of the morning. The conversations they want more of are the ones where the written rule does not fit the person in front of them.
lenses.options: When the contract is ambiguous, showing the warehouse-CAO figure beside the transport-CAO figure, and the employee answer beside the agency answer, changes whether the person is given a number, sent to payroll, or sent to the agency.
lenses.altitude: The week becomes tickets and keeping the pages true for both CAOs, three sites and agency workers. They gain the right to publish an answer and to take a topic off the front door, and the job becomes more expert on the written rules.
reach: HR Business Partner: answer the standard manager questions on leave and contract type, after learning which questions are already a case for the business partner.
Compensation and Benefits Specialist: explain a scale or an allowance from the page that specialist maintains, after learning both CAO tables well enough to see that a page is stale.

tasks.human_edge: They handle the person who is angry, worried or on long-term sick leave, and any question that turns on a promise a manager made and never wrote down.
tasks.pattern_why: A question can need a field lookup, a policy page or a person, and that choice is clear only after the question is read, so the steps are not a fixed script. Personal figures are quoted from AFAS, and the administrator sees every question the pages do not cover.

in_practice.trigger: An employee or a manager asks in a Teams channel that is marked as the HR front door.
steps: The reply states that they are talking to AI, which Article 50 already requires.
For a leave balance, a scale or a certificate date, the reply quotes the AFAS or Studytube field.
For a policy question, the reply quotes the SharePoint page for that CAO, site and contract type.
An agency worker who asks about pay receives the fixed line that names their agency.
Illness, grievances, verbal promises and low-confidence questions become a ticket with the employee number.
The administrator answers the ticket and corrects the page when the same question keeps coming.
in_practice.human_gate: The administrator answers every ticket and approves every change to the pages. Illness and grievances get no automatic reply. The works council consents before the front door reads the personnel file or logs questions per person.
data_needed: Approved pages per CAO, site and contract type
AFAS fields the door may quote: leave balance, scale, site, contract, certificate expiry
Topics that always go to a person, including health
Works-council consent and the employee notice
A marker for agency flex, so their wage is not read from AFAS
in_practice.logs_to: The HR ticket queue for unanswered questions, and SharePoint version history for the pages. Question logs per employee only in the form the works council has agreed.

evidence.claim: Coca-Cola Andina's HR agent is used monthly by 1,200 of about 3,600 employees, in nearly 5,000 conversations, with CSAT 4.1 out of 5 from 976 surveys. Unresolved questions become a ticket with the profile attached, and answers differ by region, contract type and tenure.
Danish chatbot users, including HR professionals and office clerks, saved about 3% of work hours, and about 7% where employers encouraged use.
Since 2 August 2026, people must be told they are interacting with AI unless that is obvious.
A works council's consent is required when an employer introduces a system that processes personal data, and also when a system can observe employee behaviour.

risks: If the mailbox stays open beside the front door, the Danish result says little time comes back.

A careless reply about sick leave will break trust. Andina's agent joked about sick leave and doctor's visits in the weeks before launch, and the fix was tone in the configuration plus instructions per topic.
Quoting the wrong CAO, or answering an agency worker from the Noordhaven wage file, gives a false figure.
Switching the door on before works-council consent, or logging questions so that behaviour can be watched, breaches WOR art. 27.
Inferring emotion from the messages is banned at work.
research_questions: What share of last quarter's questions was a leave balance, a scale, a certificate date, or a page that already exists on SharePoint?
If employees keep mailing the administrator as well, does any time actually leave this task?
Will the works council consent under WOR art. 27(1)(k), and under (l) if a question log can show how a person behaves?
In a real month, which questions mention health, and can those be routed to a person every time?

tasks.short: Turn an accepted offer into a contract and an AFAS file

today.trigger: A recruiter says an offer is accepted and asks HR to prepare the contract and the employee file.
steps: Read the offer in Recruitee and pick the SharePoint template for the CAO, the term and the site.
Type hours, scale, site, start date and allowances into the contract.
Send it for signature and answer the candidate's questions on the pack.
Create the employee in AFAS, store the signed contract, and enrol the mandatory courses in Studytube.
Check identity, BSN and tax details when they arrive, and chase what is still missing before day one.
drudgery: Copying the offer into the Word template
Creating the same empty AFAS employee on every hire
Chasing identity, BSN and certificates in the week before the start
today.time_sinks: Assembling the pack, then discovering on the first morning that the file is still short a document.

lenses.faster: Copying the offer into the template and opening an empty AFAS employee disappears. Checking the pack against the offer still takes several minutes, and a fixed term or an unusual allowance takes longer.
lenses.autonomous: An accepted offer in Recruitee starts a filled template and an onboarding checklist. The administrator approves the pack before it is sent for signature.
lenses.ambitious: Fixed-term night-shift hires at Tilburg and Venlo get a signed contract and a complete file before the first shift, a group that often starts with the paperwork still open. In peak season the sites would put more of those hires through HR before day one if the pack were ready within a day, so demand grows when the turnaround gets short.
lenses.joy: Nobody would miss copying hours and a start date into Word. The work they want more of is the contract with an unusual allowance, or a term that ends in the middle of a peak.
lenses.options: Two drafts from the same offer, one with the stated hours and one with the night allowance the roster assumes, can show the manager that the offer and the shift plan disagree, and they change the offer before anyone signs.
lenses.altitude: The week is packs that failed the check, and starters whose file is still open. They gain the right to refuse to send a contract that does not match the approved offer, and the job becomes more expert on the templates, while who is hired stays with the recruiter and the manager.
reach: Recruiter: prepare the contract pack once the offer is accepted, after learning the Recruitee offer fields and which template fits which CAO and term.
Learning and Development Specialist: enrol forklift, VCA or food safety at hire, after learning the mandatory matrix by role and site.

tasks.human_edge: They catch the gap between the approved offer and the shift the site really has, including hours or an allowance that was promised in conversation and never put in Recruitee.
tasks.pattern_why: The offer fields and the SharePoint templates are known, so a ruled fill can build the pack. The hiring decision has already been made by the recruiter and the manager, and identity documents stay with the administrator.

in_practice.trigger: The recruiter marks the offer accepted in Recruitee.
steps: Rules choose the SharePoint template from CAO, permanent or fixed term, hours and site. An agency flex order skips the employment contract.
The pack is filled from the offer and checked against the scale and the allowance table.
The administrator compares the pack with the offer and releases it for signature, or sends it back to the recruiter.
After signature, AFAS opens the employee from those fields and Studytube assigns the mandatory courses.
The starter submits their details in AFAS Pocket. The administrator checks identity and BSN on the dossier before day one.
in_practice.human_gate: The administrator releases every contract before it goes for signature. A mismatch with the approved offer stops the pack. The recruiter and the hiring manager have already made the hiring decision.
data_needed: Approved offer fields in Recruitee
Contract template per CAO, term and site
Scale and allowance tables
Mandatory courses by role and site
A flex marker that routes agency workers away from an employment contract
in_practice.logs_to: The Recruitee offer and the AFAS employee dossier, including the signed contract.

evidence.claim: SixFifty drafts contracts from a maintained rules base, sends them for signature, and distributes new-hire notices, with each action kept inside a fixed workflow. The product is built for US law.
AFAS Profit 8 lets new hires submit their data in the Pocket app before day one.
The hiring decision may not rest solely on automated processing. A letter itself can be produced automatically.

risks: The wrong CAO or the wrong term produces a contract the company then has to undo with the new employee.
An agency worker who receives a Noordhaven employment contract becomes an employee by mistake.
A pack sent without the administrator's read will miss hours or allowances that were agreed outside Recruitee.
Identity documents and the BSN are high-value personal data and belong in AFAS, not in a model prompt or a mail thread.
research_questions: How long does it take today from an accepted offer to a signed contract and a complete AFAS employee, and which step uses the time?
How often does the signed contract differ from the Recruitee offer?
Do the SharePoint templates cover both CAOs, fixed term and permanent, all three sites, and the night allowances?
What share of starts are agency flex and must stay off the employment-contract path?

tasks.short: Look someone up to answer a question or start an action

today.trigger: A manager, recruiter, payroll colleague or HR business partner asks for something from an employee's file.
steps: Ask what they need and for which personnel action, and whether they should see it.
Search AFAS, and sometimes SharePoint or mail, for the contract, scale, site, certificates or dates.
Copy the relevant facts into the reply or into the personnel action.
Leave medical notes and anything outside the request out of the reply.
drudgery: Clicking through AFAS tabs to collect a scale, a site and an end date
Running the same lookup for managers at three sites
Rewriting the fields into a mail that does not carry too much of the file
today.time_sinks: Finding the fields, then rewriting them into something that is safe to send.

lenses.faster: Clicking through tabs and rewriting a standard field set disappears. Releasing an extract that includes pay, absence or performance still takes several minutes to check purpose and content.
lenses.autonomous: A request for a named field set on one employee starts a query that returns only those fields. Certificate, site and contract hours for a supervisor's own team return directly. Pay, absence, performance and discipline wait for the administrator.
lenses.ambitious: A night-shift supervisor can request certificate expiry and contract hours for their own team before the shift, a group that now waits until the office opens. They would use that more often in peak season if it were available on the shift, so demand grows when a roster breaks at night and the lookup is cheap.
lenses.joy: Nobody would miss hunting for a scale across tabs. The work they want more of is the request that is really a dismissal, a conflict or a question about fitness for work.
lenses.options: Offering a short field set beside a fuller one can change whether the manager has enough to make a transfer or needs to stop and talk to the HR business partner.
lenses.altitude: The week is the releases the query will not make on its own, and the requests that should not be answered from the file. They gain the right to refuse an extract the requester is not entitled to see, and the job becomes more expert on purpose and access.
reach: HR Business Partner: prepare the field extract for a routine transfer or promotion, after learning which fields that action uses and that medical notes stay in the closed part of the file.
Payroll Specialist: pull the contract hours and scale that payroll asks for at cutoff, after learning the pay run's field list.

tasks.human_edge: They know when a lookup is really about dismissal, a grievance or fitness for work, and when the dossier is simply wrong.
tasks.pattern_why: The facts already sit in named AFAS fields, so a query can return the set that belongs to the request. The reply quotes those fields, and a person releases anything sensitive.

in_practice.trigger: A manager or a colleague asks for a named set of fields on one employee, tied to a personnel action.
steps: The requester's role and site decide which fields the query may touch.
AFAS returns that set. Medical notes and free-text absence reasons stay in the closed part of the file.
Certificate expiry, site and contract hours for a supervisor's own team are returned on the request.
Pay, absence totals, performance and discipline wait in a release queue.
The administrator releases or refuses the queued extract and attaches it to the personnel action.
in_practice.human_gate: The administrator releases every extract that contains pay, absence, performance or discipline, and refuses a request that has no legitimate personnel action behind it.
data_needed: Field sets per purpose: transfer, promotion, certificate check, payroll cutoff
Who may see which field, by role and by site
AFAS employee number
A closed section for medical notes that the query cannot read
in_practice.logs_to: The AFAS audit trail of the lookup, and the personnel action the extract was attached to.

evidence.claim: Andina's HR agent answers from the personnel system, with the answer differing by contract type and tenure, and attaches the employee profile when a question becomes a ticket.
Works-council consent is required for a system that processes personnel data, and for one that can monitor behaviour.
From 2 December 2027, AI that monitors employee performance is high-risk under Annex III 4(b).
Health data in the absence file is special-category data and should stay out of a model prompt. A lookup can return dates and codes.

risks: A supervisor who can open any file will browse, which the works council can treat as monitoring.
An absence percentage can reveal a health situation even when the diagnosis stays hidden.
An extract pasted into Teams can be forwarded to people who were not allowed to see it.
A lookup that grows into a performance report would be high-risk from 2 December 2027.
research_questions: Which requests are a fixed set of fields, and which are really a judgment about discipline, dismissal or fitness?
Does AFAS already restrict salary, absence and performance by role, or do administrators rely on habit?
How often is the dossier empty or wrong at the moment someone asks?
Will the works council require consent before supervisors run a self-service lookup that logs who viewed whom?

tasks.short: Chase other teams for missing personnel documents

today.trigger: A dossier is missing a document that a department, a manager, an employee or an agency holds.
steps: See what is missing from the checklist or from the request for a personnel action.
Work out who has it: the employee, a supervisor, the recruiter, Learning and Development, or one of the three agencies.
Send a mail or a Teams message, and keep a reminder list.
File what comes back, or escalate when the start date or payroll cutoff is close.
drudgery: Keeping the reminder list in Excel
Writing the same request for a certificate or a starter form
Saving what finally arrives under the right person
today.time_sinks: Waiting on people who are on shift or inside an agency, and sending the second and third reminder.

lenses.faster: Writing the standard reminder and tracking it in Excel disappears. A case with no reply still needs a call or an escalation and can take a quarter of an hour or more, and those cases are where most of the time already goes.
lenses.autonomous: A missing required item on an AFAS checklist starts a reminder to the known owner when the item is a standard certificate or a starter form. The administrator takes over when the due date passes, the owner is unknown, or the document is sensitive.
lenses.ambitious: Seasonal flex workers arrive with site papers in place — identity check confirmed, VCA valid, and the hours approver named — before the first shift, a group of 150 to 300 people whose file is usually thin. Sites and agencies would ask for this at every peak if the chase were reliable, because a missing VCA already stops a shift, so demand grows each season once the chase is cheap.
lenses.joy: Nobody would miss the reminder spreadsheet. The work they want more of is the hard chase: the night supervisor who answers only the phone, or the agency that sent another worker's certificate.
lenses.options: Sending the next ask to the employee, to the night supervisor, or to the agency changes whether the paper arrives before the shift and who is accountable for the gap.
lenses.altitude: The week is the chases that are past their due date, especially those that block a start. They gain the right to escalate a blocking gap to the site lead or the HR business partner, and the job becomes more expert on who holds which document across three sites and three agencies.
reach: Learning and Development Specialist: chase expired forklift, VCA and food-safety certificates, after learning the mandatory list and the Studytube enrolment screen.
Recruiter: collect the missing hire documents before day one, after learning the starter checklist and which items the agency supplies for flex.

tasks.human_edge: They know who will actually answer — a night supervisor, a planner at an agency, a manager who leaves mail unread — and they can get the document without burning that relationship.
tasks.pattern_why: The missing item and its usual owner come from a checklist, so the reminder and the due date are rules. A person steps in when the owner is wrong, the reply never comes, or the document is sensitive.

in_practice.trigger: An AFAS checklist shows a required document missing, or a personnel action is blocked by a gap.
steps: The checklist names the gap and the usual owner: employee, supervisor, recruiter, Learning and Development, or a named agency.
For a standard certificate or starter form, a Teams or mail reminder goes out with a due date.
A document that comes back is filed only after the dossier check matches the employee and the document type.
The administrator picks up anything still open on the due date, any unknown owner, and any grievance, medical or performance document.
in_practice.human_gate: Standard certificate and starter-form reminders go out on their own. The administrator handles silence, an unknown owner, and every request for a grievance, medical or performance document.
data_needed: Required documents by event: hire, certificate renewal, flex start
Usual owner of each document
Due date against the start date or payroll cutoff
Which of the three agencies employs the flex worker
in_practice.logs_to: The checklist on the AFAS dossier, including reminder dates and the date the document was filed.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit 8 lets new hires submit data in the Pocket app before day one, which removes the chase for items the starter can provide themselves.
SixFifty distributes new-hire notices as one action inside a fixed workflow on a maintained rules base. The product is US law.
A reminder beside an unchanged Excel chase adds little. People on shifts answer when the channel and the owner are right, which a due date alone does not fix.

risks: Automatic reminders to night supervisors who already ignore mail will only add noise.
A standard mail that chases a medical or grievance document spreads special-category data.
The agency portals sit outside AFAS, and a reminder cannot fetch a paper the agency will not release.
A wrong owner on the checklist sends the chase to the wrong site or the wrong agency.
research_questions: Which documents are missing most often, who holds them, and how many days do they take to arrive?
What share of chases are a standard certificate or starter form, and what share are one-off requests to a manager?
Do night-shift supervisors and the three agencies answer Teams or mail, or only a phone call?
Once Pocket and Studytube collect the starter items before day one, how many chases are left?

role.altitude: The two administrators become the people who keep the AFAS file and the staff answers accurate for both CAOs and the three sites, and who spend the week on what the workflows stop: illness files, grievances, contracts that do not match the offer, and papers that block a start date.
reach: Recruiter: build the contract pack after the offer is accepted and keep the starter file complete through day one, after learning the offer fields, the templates, and which starts are agency flex.
Learning and Development Specialist: enrol and chase forklift, VCA and food-safety certificates, after learning the role-and-site matrix in Studytube.
Payroll Specialist: deliver checked address, hours and leaver changes before cutoff, after learning the fields and codes the pay run accepts.
HR Business Partner: prepare the extract for a routine transfer or promotion, after learning which fields may be released and which cases stay with the business partner.
role.ceiling_note: The eight tasks are 45% of this role's time. Two people at this cost cannot also take hiring decisions, the pay calculation, or the HR business partner's casework. Health data, works-council consent, and the high-risk line on applicant screening from 2 December 2027 cap what may run unattended. Flex headcount swings from 150 to 300 and the agency is their employer, so those workers will never have a full Noordhaven dossier.
skills_to_grow: AFAS workflow and the source of truth for each field, including how to clear an exceptions queue before payroll cutoff.
Both CAOs, far enough to spot a wrong scale, allowance, contract term or leaver code.
AVG limits on health data and on logs, Article 50's duty to say it is AI, and what the works council must consent to under WOR art. 27.
Recruitee offer stages and the Studytube mandatory-course list, so both feed the dossier.
Writing short staff answers per site, contract type and CAO, and withdrawing a page that has gone stale.
role.ambitious_version: They run one front door for the three sites, both CAOs, the night shifts and the agency desk. A fixed-term starter's file is complete before the first shift, and a repeat question is answered on the shift. Their own week goes to the cases that move the result HR is judged on: a new hire who may not be productive and still here at day 90, and an illness file that is nearing a Wet verbetering poortwachter deadline. Hiring decisions stay with the recruiter and the manager. The pay run stays with the payroll specialist.
